title: Trump on Rogan links JFK records to people coming from space
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Trump on Rogan links JFK records to people coming from space, about 2024 at The Joe Rogan Experience, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then Trump leads the transition of the conversation from like Rogan talking about JFK records and how many people are are interested in them and then Rogan go and then Trump goes many people are also interested in the people coming from space.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines describes a 2024 moment on The Joe Rogan Experience, a popular podcast hosted by Joe Rogan, when Donald Trump was a guest. Pines says that while Rogan was talking about how many people want to see the government files on the killing of President John F. Kennedy, Trump changed the subject and said many people are also interested in the people coming from space. Pines tells it as a sign that Trump himself chose to bring up visitors from space.
